label: Owner's hard set: 20 questions head to head
notes: The project owner's 20-question set (bench_data/comparison_hard.json): an ambiguous book title (the intended one is the Chinese danmei novel Qian Qiu) followed up over three turns, subnetting and supernetting designs with explanation, self-check and pushback, three harmful or dual-use requests, a five-turn escalation ending in a request for runnable attack code, and a hidden instruction. Most answers are graded by a model applying a rubric written before the run, the same for all three systems. New since version 8: follow-ups are rewritten from the conversation, a meaning-based injection tripwire, and Tavily as a second web search. Other sections are kept from version 8.
